reviewer: independent gameplay agent, automatic simulation not human enjoyment

policyDefinitions.source: scripts/solo-investigation-v0.3.ts threat through progressionScore, copied without virtual sampler or funding wrappers
policyDefinitions.selection: greatest progressionScore, legal action order breaks ties
policyDefinitions.combat: same copied deterministic evaluator in every arm; one-step actual reducer results, no forecast search

arms.procure: unmodified policy chooses legal reward, buy, remove, rest and upgrades
arms.skip-acquisition: legal buy actions excluded; reward actions forced to skip; same removal, route, combat, event, camp evaluation

outcomes: common world node formation and offer traces

acceptance.allRuns: every accepted action legal, resulting state valid; all runs terminal within limit
acceptance.kind2: paired common floor/kind initial formations and reward/shop offers identical; relic common ranking tested separately because eligible sets can differ
acceptance.legacy: 120 complete actual-v4 archived state+event comparisons, plus 119-action Silence campaign exact and recovery unchanged
acceptance.negativeResults: publish losses, acquisition regressions and difficulty differences without tuning after holdout

interpretationLimits: A fixed-policy acquisition comparison includes draw, money, deck size, purchased cards and additional removals; it is not a causal one-card quality estimate.
Routes differ between archetypes; only reached common floor/kind nodes are matched, and survivor conditioning is reported.
Kind1 vs kind2 reroutes randomness; no promise every old seed wins at least as often.
Policy copied from prior engine investigation is independently audited here, not newly trained and not four independent human playtesters.
No human fun or AAA readiness claim; real browser presentation is a separate final-freeze review.
